text: Build the records-branch writer of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md section 8.2, decision D111, job 1 part 2): in athena-git, a writer that commits opaque record files to the branch athena/records (its own root, never merged into main) with compare-and-swap and bounded retry. Tests: two simultaneous writers both land, each as its own path, fast-forward only; a rejected update refetches, replays and succeeds; a write that would modify, delete or rename an existing path is refused and the tip is unchanged; the branch has no parent in common with main. Nothing in the job pipeline calls it yet.
